snippet.title: SAND: Raiders of Sophie - Launch Trailer | Out Now On Steam
snippet.description:
Buy SAND: Raiders of Sophie now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431300/Sand

Now available in Early Access! Build your highly customizable walking base. Squad up or go solo. Gather loot, weapons, and precious artifacts. Clash with other players in a brutal, procedurally generated desert forged by history and chaos.

Developed by team Hologryph in Lviv, Ukraine. Support Ukraine - https://u24.gov.ua/
